caption: The drawing features five vertically oriented rectangular panels arranged in two rows: three along the top and two along the bottom. Each panel is labeled with a number below it: "NO. 1," "NO. 2," and "NO. 3" along the top row from left to right, and "NO. 4" and "NO. 5" along the bottom row from left to right. All five panels depict stylized representations of wood grain patterns. "NO. 1" is drawn only with light, fine lines, with no color. "NO. 2" introduces brown and some blue hues, showing more detail on the upper part of the panel with the lower part remaining light. "NO. 3" continues the wood grain with a more uniform light brown wash, which fades towards the bottom. "NO. 4" is filled with a more solid light brown color throughout the wood grain pattern. "NO. 5" presents the most saturated and dark brown coloring, with the lower part fading slightly. The entire composition is set against a plain off-white or cream background. In the bottom right corner of the image, the name "HARRY MANN WADDELL" is written.
title: Technique Demo (Wood Grain)
